name: Buying: family road-trip EV under $45k in 2026
why: The answer has to compare real 2026 models under $45k on range, fast-charging access (Supercharger/NACS vs CCS adapters, charging speed) and reliability, and note that the $7,500 federal credit ended on September 30, 2025.
question: Which EV under $45k is best for a US family that road-trips, in 2026? Range, charging network, reliability.
